keywords.title: Seed keywords
keywords.description: Seed terms to analyse on Google Trends (e.g. "botox", "microneedling", "dermaplaning").

geo.title: Location (geo code)
geo.description: 2-letter country code to scope trends (e.g. AE for United Arab Emirates, US, GB). Leave empty for worldwide.

includeRising.title: Include rising queries
includeRising.description: Include the fastest-rising related queries (the core of a trend radar).

includeTop.title: Include top queries
includeTop.description: Include the most popular related queries.

rateLimitDelay.title: Delay between keywords (seconds)
rateLimitDelay.description: Delay between keywords to avoid Google Trends rate limiting (429).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy for outgoing requests. Google Trends rate-limits aggressively, so RESIDENTIAL is recommended.
